data.name: Eeshaal
data.long_meaning: Eeshaal is derived from the Arabic root 'ishal' which means to make something easy or to facilitate. It is related to the concept of living a life of ease and comfort.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic context, Eeshaal can be related to the concept of being blessed with a comfortable and easy life, as mentioned in the Quran, 'And if they had believed and been mindful of Allah, His reward would have been better for them, if they only knew.' (Quran 2:103)
